snippet.title: BBC Bitesize for Teachers
snippet.description:
Bitesize for Teachers (formerly BBC Teach) offers free classroom resources to schools throughout the UK.

Find thousands of free curriculum-linked class clips on Bitesize for Teachers to help you deliver lessons - all arranged by subject and age group.

We cover 22 subjects, ranging from early years to GCSE/Nationals and Highers.

For major events, such as Black History Month or Shakespeare Season, BBC Teach also curates collections pages featuring content and links to relevant pages from around the rest of the BBC.

BBC Teach content is in the process of being migrated to bbc.co.uk/teach - try out the new site if you are unable to find the clip you are looking for here.

snippet.title: Homo Historica
snippet.description:
Homo Historica — Ancient history, told in whispers.
For minds that wander backwards.

Before cities, before kings—before even memory—there were stories.
At Homo Historica, we guide you gently through the silent centuries: the lives of prehistoric humans, the long dark of the Ice Age, the birth of firelight and language. All told slowly, softly, and with care.

These are bedtime documentaries designed for sleep, curiosity, or stillness—woven from anthropology, myth, and the archaeology of forgotten lives.

🌍 Expect:
— Immersive journeys into deep prehistory
— Second-person narration for restful escape
— Calm, poetic storytelling rooted in real history
— The emotional and daily lives of our earliest ancestors
— A quiet refuge for those who still feel the pull of deep time

No music. No clutter. Just long form history to fall asleep to.
Let the past keep watch while you rest.

snippet.title: Bedtime & Historian
snippet.description:
🌙Hi, I’m Tony. I’ve always loved history, and I believe the best way to enjoy it is through stories. I started Bedtime & Historian to share that love with people who enjoy it as much as I do.
   This channel is all about bedtime history: calm, carefully researched stories told in a way that helps you unwind at the end of the day. 
🔥My goal is simple to make history feel alive told in a gentle, soothing way that can guide you into rest at night. But these stories aren’t only for sleep you can let them keep you company while driving, cooking, studying, or whenever you want a calm voice and timeless story in the background.

-  Check out my new channel (Bedtime & Scientist) bringing the same comforting storytelling style with a new focus on science, nature, and relaxing science facts designed to help you drift off while learning something new. (clicking on the link below)

▶️ Hit play. Close your eyes. Let the past put you to bed.
Subscribe and let history do the rest.

Using advanced AI reconstruction and cinematic storytelling, we don't just tell history. We rebuild it. Every episode takes you inside worlds that no longer exist — walking ancient streets, witnessing disasters as they unfolded, and exploring the hidden forces that shaped the modern world.
This is not a history class. This is a vault of everything they didn't tell you.
The past is waiting. Step inside.

Subscribe to join me on this journey and explore the hidden stories of our human heritage.

snippet.title: Dayinlifehistory
snippet.description:
Step into the past and see history like never before! Day in Life History brings you immersive, short videos that take you inside the daily lives of people and animals from different eras.

Ever wondered what it was like to be an Egyptian pyramid worker, a coal miner in the 1800s, or even a cat wandering ancient temples? Through rich visuals, engaging storytelling, and captivating voiceovers, we bring forgotten worlds to life—one 60-second story at a time.

🔹 Experience history through the eyes of those who lived it
🔹 Unique perspectives, from workers to warriors to animals
🔹 Short, engaging videos that transport you back in time

Subscribe now and take a journey through history, one story at a time! 🏛️⏳🐾 #DayInLifeHistory #HistoryReimagined

snippet.title: Past and Future cities AI
snippet.description: Welcome to Past and Future Cities. My aim is to create educational documentaries that bring history—and future urbanism—to life. I look beyond the textbooks to reveal the immersive details of the past. Using advanced reconstruction technology, I visualize lost worlds, from the Roman Empire to Victorian London and Asian history. My goal is to make archaeology and storytelling accessible to everyone.

snippet.title: Lauren Learns History
snippet.description:
Hello and welcome! I'm Lauren and I'm on a mission to find out about the incredible people, stories and events from history that have shaped the world we live in...

In each episode, I invite you to join me as I step back in time to meet historical characters in fascinating locations! 

Are you ready for a voyage of discovery?

📺 We release new episodes at least once a month!

🎥 The channel is filmed alongside my husband, Ian and in collaboration with museums, actors, historians and historic interpreters all over the UK who help to make this possible!

Thanks for SUBSCRIBING and I look forward to voyaging through time with you! 😊

Help support our work at...
https://patreaon.com/laurenlearnshistory
https://Ko-Fi.com/laurenlearnshistory
